# Public native HTTP histories

These four reports came from actual separate-process application/proxy/dependency
experiments in the newly owned development Kind `themis-t42-449bf2858d1c`.
They preserve actual signed fixture responses, unsigned client durations, source
verdicts and cleanup dispositions. They contain no private key, execution or cleanup
capability, kubeconfig or token. The final milestone handoff retains newer full
execution evidence and distinguishes source/image snapshots.

Self-contained installer/fixture keys are not an offline trust root. Source replay
can recompute these supported predicates but always retains whole trusted execution
INCONCLUSIVE and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_ATTESTED. T4.3 will add full native signed-witness
and authorization/evidence integration; these fixtures do not claim it already exists.
